tool_input.command: ls -la data/ && echo "---TRAINING---" && head -5 data/training_sample.csv && echo "---SERVING---" && head -5 data/serving_log.csv && echo "---COUNTS---" && wc -l data/training_sample.csv data/serving_log.csv
hops fg list --json 2>&1 | head -40; echo "---CONTEXT---"; hops context 2>&1 | head -30
tool_input.description: List feature groups and project context

tool_input.command: hops fg --help 2>&1 | head -40; echo "===CREATE==="; hops fg create --help 2>&1 | head -50
hops fg insert --help 2>&1 | head -40; echo "===SQL==="; hops sql --help 2>&1 | head -30

hops fg create skew_train --primary-key entity_id --features "entity_id:string,f1:double,f2:double,f3:double,f4:double,f5:double" --description "training sample features" --json 2>&1 | tail -5
echo "===CREATE SERVE==="
hops fg create skew_serve --primary-key entity_id --features "entity_id:string,f1:double,f2:double,f3:double,f4:double,f5:double" --description "serving log features" --json 2>&1 | tail -5
hops fg insert skew_train --version 1 --file data/training_sample.csv --json 2>&1 | tail -8
hops fg insert skew_serve --version 1 --file data/serving_log.csv --json 2>&1 | tail -8
hops sql "SELECT table_name FROM iceberg.information_schema.tables WHERE table_name LIKE 'skew%'" --json 2>&1 | tail -20
hops sql --no-verify "SELECT table_name FROM iceberg.information_schema.tables WHERE table_name LIKE 'skew%'" --json 2>&1 | tail -20

hops sql --no-verify --json "
SELECT
  count(*) AS n,
  avg(abs(t.f1 - s.f1)) AS mad_f1,
  avg(abs(t.f2 - s.f2)) AS mad_f2,
  avg(abs(t.f3 - s.f3)) AS mad_f3,
  avg(abs(t.f4 - s.f4)) AS mad_f4,
  avg(abs(t.f5 - s.f5)) AS mad_f5
FROM skew_train_1 t JOIN skew_serve_1 s ON t.entity_id = s.entity_id
" 2>&1 | tail -15
tool_input.description: Compare mean absolute differences per feature

tool_input.command: hops sql --no-verify --json "SELECT table_schema, table_name FROM iceberg.information_schema.tables WHERE table_name LIKE 'skew%'" 2>&1 | tail -12

hops sql --no-verify --schema mlpab059eea_featurestore --json "
SELECT
  count(*) AS n,
  avg(abs(t.f1 - s.f1)) AS mad_f1,
  avg(abs(t.f2 - s.f2)) AS mad_f2,
  avg(abs(t.f3 - s.f3)) AS mad_f3,
  avg(abs(t.f4 - s.f4)) AS mad_f4,
  avg(abs(t.f5 - s.f5)) AS mad_f5
FROM skew_train_1 t JOIN skew_serve_1 s ON t.entity_id = s.entity_id
" 2>&1 | tail -15
tool_input.description: Compare MAD per feature for matched entities

tool_input.command:
hops sql --no-verify --catalog delta --schema mlpab059eea_featurestore --json "
SELECT
  count(*) AS n,
  avg(abs(t.f1 - s.f1)) AS mad_f1,
  avg(abs(t.f2 - s.f2)) AS mad_f2,
  avg(abs(t.f3 - s.f3)) AS mad_f3,
  avg(abs(t.f4 - s.f4)) AS mad_f4,
  avg(abs(t.f5 - s.f5)) AS mad_f5
FROM skew_train_1 t JOIN skew_serve_1 s ON t.entity_id = s.entity_id
" 2>&1 | tail -15
tool_input.description: Compare MAD per feature via delta catalog

tool_input.command:
hops sql --no-verify --catalog delta --schema mlpab059eea_featurestore --json "
SELECT
  avg(t.f4) AS avg_train, avg(s.f4) AS avg_serve,
  min(t.f4) AS min_train, max(t.f4) AS max_train,
  min(s.f4) AS min_serve, max(s.f4) AS max_serve,
  avg(s.f4 - t.f4) AS mean_signed_diff,
  corr(t.f4, s.f4) AS corr_f4,
  avg(CASE WHEN t.f4 <> 0 THEN s.f4 / t.f4 END) AS avg_ratio
FROM skew_train_1 t JOIN skew_serve_1 s ON t.entity_id = s.entity_id
" 2>&1 | tail -14

hops sql --no-verify --catalog delta --schema mlpab059eea_featurestore --json "
SELECT
  corr(s.f4, exp(t.f4) - 1)        AS corr_serve_vs_expm1train,
  avg(abs(s.f4 - (exp(t.f4) - 1))) AS mad_serve_vs_expm1train,
  corr(t.f4, ln(s.f4 + 1))         AS corr_train_vs_log1pserve,
  avg(abs(t.f4 - ln(s.f4 + 1)))    AS mad_train_vs_log1pserve
FROM skew_train_1 t JOIN skew_serve_1 s ON t.entity_id = s.entity_id
" 2>&1 | tail -10
